_comment: Copy this file to webapp_config.json (gitignored) or let the webapp create it on the first 'Set as default' tap. All keys are optional — missing keys fall back to the defaults documented in src/webapp_config.py.
_comment_auth_token: Empty string = auth gate OFF (the default). Run scripts/gen_token.py to generate a strong token; the webapp will then require Authorization: Bearer <token> on every API call from non-loopback callers. See README → 'Optional: bearer-token auth'.
_comment_auth_password: Optional companion to auth_token: when set, a fresh device with no token shows a login overlay; entering the password swaps it for the bearer token. Set/clear via scripts/set_password.py. Failed attempts are logged to webapp/auth.log.
_comment_polish_prompts: polish_prompt_default picks one of the entries in config/polish_prompts.json (committed). Add new entries there to expose more polish styles in the webapp + tk window — no code change needed.
_comment_silence: Peak-RMS dBFS threshold below which a take skips whisper entirely (so it can't hallucinate 'Thanks for watching' on silence). Default -50 is conservative; lower (-55) to be more permissive, raise (-45) if hallucinations still slip through.
_comment_latency: Rolling transcription: re-run whisper on the accumulated take every N seconds while still recording so the transcript box is already filled by the time you tap Stop. Set partial_interval_seconds to 0 to disable. VAD-driven auto-stop (off by default): when on, the client auto-stops after auto_stop_silence_ms of continuous near-silence (with a 500 ms 'keep talking to cancel' grace banner).
